headline: OAK @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.34 at HOU 4.91, with a projected total of 9.24. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: OAK moved +0.99 runs while HOU moved +0.33, changing the projected margin by +0.66 runs. The projected total climbed +1.32, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Jeremy Peña, Tyler Soderstrom, Yordan Alvarez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags LaMonte Wade Jr., Lawrence Butler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
